findings.title: The star field does not provide the required parallax
findings.claim: The plan fixes stars in screen space, so they never move when the camera pans. It does not justify this departure from the parent spec.
findings.evidence: Plan L63 and L1558–1565; parent spec L232; H-1 spec L3 and L103.
findings.why: Parallax is part of the H-1a Helm background, and the refined spec says the parent wins where they disagree.
findings.fix: Keep the seeded stars, but derive their screen positions from camera movement at a reduced rate. Add a camera-pan assertion.

findings.title: Dragging and wheeling in one frame loses cursor-anchored zoom
findings.claim: The runtime applies wheel zoom before pan; pan then clears the zoom anchor. A simultaneous drag and wheel therefore zooms about the centre even after the camera becomes free.
findings.why: This is a normal combined pointer gesture, and the result contradicts the plan’s free-camera wheel behavior.
findings.fix: Apply the drag before wheel zoom, then test a frame containing both inputs.

findings.title: The browser-default test omits key release
findings.claim: The input test asserts preventDefault only on keydown, although the plan requires it on keydown and keyup.
findings.why: A regression that lets Tab, Space, arrows, or Backspace act on release would pass this test.
findings.fix: Dispatch keyup for each protected key and assert preventDefault.
